title: REQ · rejectExecution client call POSTs to the admin reject endpoint
summary: rejectExecution(token, id) POSTs to /api/v1/admin/executions/{id}/reject with the admin Bearer token and returns ExecutionInfo.
description: Context: approveExecution and retryExecution wrap adminRequest in client.ts (about L92-L105). Desired behavior: a sibling rejectExecution does the same for the reject path. Expected result: callers get the ExecutionInfo the server returns, or an ApiError on failure. Why: the admin UI needs a client call before it can offer Reject.
acceptance_criteria: Given token 'tok' and id 'exec-1', when rejectExecution is called, then fetch receives URL /api/v1/admin/executions/exec-1/reject with method POST and header Authorization 'Bearer tok'.
Given a 200 response with an execution JSON body, when rejectExecution resolves, then it returns that execution.
Given a 401 response, when rejectExecution is called, then it rejects with ApiError status 401.
technical_constraints: Mirror approveExecution exactly except for the path suffix.
definition_of_done: Function exported and covered by unit tests.
